selector: sha256(dataset_sha || split || canonical_example_id) ascending, A/B/C/D exactly, <=208 prompt tokens, no duplicate text, no source/dev overlap
input_format: Qwen chat-template user question and four labelled options; assistant single-letter A/B/C/D correct answer token; all alternatives must be single tokens with exact common prefix
sample_scores: BF16 original-only cross entropy of correct one-token label, per-item gradient g of each projection W; empirical directional Fisher E[(g·(Q4(W)-W))²] and E[(g·(Q8(W)-W))²]; quantization exact native C encoders Q4G64 and qNg64 n8
objective: maximize sum of directional Fisher penalty reductions Q4 to n8 under exact 28 upgrades/196, original <=830570496 bytes, estimated <=100ms sequential CPU and <=50ms native CPU async stage; no downstream perturbed-model intervention
